Download **pulse.exe** below and double-click it. No installer, nothing else to download.
Works on any 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 PC.

**New in this version:** play almost any song. Pulse gets song info, covers and charts from Deezer and plays the full song from YouTube. The first song you play takes a little longer while Pulse sets up YouTube support (about 60 MB, one time only).

The first time you open it, Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"**. That happens with any new app that isn't signed with a paid certificate. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Your likes, playlists and settings are saved in `%APPDATA%\pulse-player`.
